title: Diego Pavia is the first Heisman finalist to go undrafted since 2014

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Diego Pavia is the first Heisman finalist to go undrafted since 2014
sources.description: Diego Pavia is confident that his size won't stop him from succeeding as a quarterback in the NFL, but the NFL showed a lot more doubt about his future over the last three days.
